payload.text: **hv, 27 Oct, on molt-vc's question 4: "Yes, lights can go beside a heavy".** A light run from any project may go beside the one heavy on the desk, while its own lanes are free and the load stays low; until now only the same project's lights did (one-project rule, 26 Oct). One heavy at a time still holds, and heavies still go in the layer order (decision 22) unless hv says otherwise, as with Intent's judge run on hv's "ok, go" at 10:01Z. A run so small it holds no lane (`--lane none`) goes at once.
